environment.inputSnapshotCost: not calibrated: load-only visits do not arm a consent action, dispatch trusted input or serialize input/unload snapshots; no overhead correction is applied
environment.minimalArm: main-document native paint/LCP observer with timer and snapshot queue drain after a 250 ms presentation grace, shared CDP emulation and Performance domain; no DOM polling, web-vitals or network listeners

reasons: Validation median missed Chrome's target score by more than 15%.
